magic-gvhd.l: Skin stage, ACTIVE ERYTHEMA ONLY [0 = No active (erythematous) GVHD rash; 1 = Maculopapular rash under 25 percent of body surface area; 2 = Maculopapular rash 25 to 50 percent of body surface area; 3 = Maculopapular rash over 50 percent of body surface area; 4 = Generalized erythroderma over 50 percent BSA PLUS bullous formation PLUS desquamation over 5 percent BSA. All three are required.]
Liver stage by bilirubin [0 = Bilirubin under 2 mg/dL; 1 = Bilirubin 2 to 3 mg/dL; 2 = Bilirubin 3.1 to 6 mg/dL; 3 = Bilirubin 6.1 to 15 mg/dL; 4 = Bilirubin over 15 mg/dL]
Upper GI stage. ONLY 0 OR 1 EXIST - there is no upper-GI stage 2, 3 or 4 [0 = No or intermittent nausea, vomiting or anorexia; 1 = Persistent nausea, vomiting or anorexia]

Lower GI stage. Stage 4 is QUALITATIVE and overrides volume [0 = Adult: under 500 mL/day or under 3 episodes/day. Child: under 10 mL/kg/day or under 4 episodes/day.; 1 = Adult: 500 to 999 mL/day or 3 to 4 episodes/day. Child: 10 to 19.9 mL/kg/day or 4 to 6 episodes/day.; 2 = Adult: 1000 to 1500 mL/day or 5 to 7 episodes/day. Child: 20 to 30 mL/kg/day or 7 to 10 episodes/day.; 3 = Adult: over 1500 mL/day or over 7 episodes/day. Child: over 30 mL/kg/day or over 10 episodes/day.; 4 = Severe abdominal pain with or without ileus, OR grossly bloody stool, REGARDLESS OF STOOL VOLUME.]

malt-ipi.l: Ann Arbor stage III or IV
Elevated LDH (above upper limit of normal)

manning-ibs.l: Pain linked to more frequent bowel movements
Looser stools with the onset of pain
Pain relieved by passage of stool
Mucus with stool >25% of the time

mapi-asthma.l: Wheezing episodes in the past year. A literal COUNT, gating at 4 or more. NOT the original API's 1-to-5 rating scale.
MAJOR criterion. Allergic sensitization to at least one aeroallergen ADDED in the mAPI; not in the original API.
MINOR criterion. Wheezing unrelated to colds
MINOR criterion. Blood eosinophils 4 percent or more
MINOR criterion. Allergic sensitization to milk, egg, or peanut REPLACED allergic rhinitis, which was removed from the original API and is NOT scored here.
Optional blood eosinophil percentage. If supplied it DECIDES the eosinophil criterion, which is 4 percent OR MORE, so exactly 4.0 meets it.

marburg-heart-score.l: Patient assumes the pain is cardiac

masaoka-koga.l: Microscopic transcapsular invasion (through the capsule) — Stage IIa
Macroscopic invasion into surrounding fat, or gross adherence to (not through) pleura/pericardium — Stage IIb
Macroscopic invasion into a neighboring organ (pericardium, great vessel, lung) — Stage III
Pleural or pericardial dissemination (separate implant nodules) — Stage IVa
Lymphogenous or hematogenous (nodal/distant) metastasis — Stage IVb

mascc.l: Solid tumor / no prior fungal infection

max-allowable-blood-loss.l: Target (minimum acceptable) hematocrit or hemoglobin (same measure)

mayo-adpkd.l: Imaging morphology class, a RADIOLOGIST'S DESCRIPTOR that cannot be inferred from the numbers. Class 2 receives no subclass at all [1 = Bilateral and diffuse distribution, with mild, moderate or severe replacement of kidney tissue by cysts, where all cysts contribute similarly to total kidney volume. 2A = Unilateral, segmental, asymmetric or lopsided presentation. 2B = Bilateral presentation with acquired unilateral atrophy, or bilateral kidney atrophy.]
Total kidney volume in mL, BOTH KIDNEYS SUMMED. Required for class 1; not used for class 2.
Patient height in METRES (not cm). Required for class 1. The volume is divided by this to give the height-adjusted volume.
Patient age in years. Required for class 1, and must be at least 15: the model is not validated below that and age sits in a denominator inside an exponent.

Optional. How the volume was measured. Recorded but NOT used in the arithmetic; the ellipsoid method overestimates stereologic volume by about 5.3 percent on average, enough to shift a subclass [stereologic = Stereologic (planimetric) measurement; ellipsoid = Ellipsoid equation: pi/6 x length x width x depth]

mayo-olecranon.l: Ulnohumeral joint stability (required when displaced): stable or unstable

mayo-spn.l: History of extrathoracic cancer (> 5 years prior)

mb-later-score.l: AF type (0 = paroxysmal, 1 = persistent, 2 = long-standing persistent)

mbi-validate.l: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (11 characters, hyphens optional)

mccormack-lsc.l: Fragment apposition/spread: 1 = minimal (< 2 mm), 2 = ≥ 2 mm over ≥ half the surface, 3 = wide spread

Patient global disease activity <= 20 on a 0-100 mm VAS

mdq.l: Several symptoms during the same period

meld-childpugh.l: Hemodialysis at least twice in past week

meld3.l: >= 2 dialysis sessions in prior week / 24h CVVHD (sets creatinine to 3.0)

mest-c.l: M - Mesangial hypercellularity. Scored from the mesangial hypercellularity score, not from a percentage of glomeruli: sources reproducing it as a percentage disagree about the boundary at exactly 50 percent, while the score threshold of 0.5 is consistent. [M0 — mesangial hypercellularity score at or below 0.5; M1 — mesangial hypercellularity score above 0.5]
E - Endocapillary hypercellularity. Present in any glomerulus is enough for E1. [E0 — absent; E1 — present in any glomerulus]
S - Segmental glomerulosclerosis. Any segmental sclerosis or adhesion. [S0 — absent; S1 — present]

T - Tubular atrophy and interstitial fibrosis. Estimated as a share of the cortical area, not of glomeruli. [T0 — 0 to 25 percent of cortical area; T1 — 26 to 50 percent of cortical area; T2 — above 50 percent of cortical area]

C - Cellular or fibrocellular crescents. Added by the 2016 update. Scored on the glomeruli sampled, so a biopsy with few glomeruli can miss focal crescents. [C0 — no crescents; C1 — crescents in above 0 and below 25 percent of glomeruli; C2 — crescents in 25 percent or more of glomeruli]

Peripheral vascular disease or rest pain

mfi-5.l: Partially or totally dependent functional status

mpa-acr-eular-2022.l: Fibrosis or interstitial lung disease on chest imaging (+3)
Nasal involvement — bloody discharge, ulcers, crusting, congestion, blockage, or septal defect/perforation (-3)

mswat.l: Whether the patient is erythrodermic. REQUIRED: it selects the lesion vocabulary (patch and plaque versus mild and moderate infiltration), though the weights and the arithmetic are identical either way.

Percent body surface area of "Patch (flat lesion)" (erythrodermic) / "Mild infiltration" (nonerythrodermic). WEIGHT 1. Counted once per square centimetre: the three categories are mutually exclusive and together cannot exceed 100 percent.

Percent body surface area of "Plaque (raised lesion)" (erythrodermic) / "Moderate infiltration" (nonerythrodermic). WEIGHT 2. Counted once per square centimetre: the three categories are mutually exclusive and together cannot exceed 100 percent.

Percent body surface area of "Tumor or ulcer" (erythrodermic) / "Tumor or ulcer" (nonerythrodermic). WEIGHT 4. Counted once per square centimetre: the three categories are mutually exclusive and together cannot exceed 100 percent.

must-nutrition.l: Unplanned weight loss in past 3-6 months
Acutely ill and no intake for > 5 days (+2)

myeloma-r-iss.l: High-risk iFISH: del(17p), t(4;14), or t(14;16)

myxedema-coma.l: Thermoregulatory dysfunction. A LADDER - one option only [above-35 = Above 35 degrees C (above 95 F) (0); 32-35 = 32 to 35 degrees C (89.6 to 95 F) (10); below-32 = Below 32 degrees C (below 89.6 F) (20)]

Central nervous system effects. A LADDER - one option only [absent = Absent (0); somnolent = Somnolent or lethargic (10); obtunded = Obtunded (15); stupor = Stupor (20); coma-seizures = Coma or seizures (30)]

Gastrointestinal findings. A LADDER - one option only [absent = Absent (0); anorexia = Anorexia, abdominal pain or constipation (5); decreased-motility = Decreased intestinal motility (15); paralytic-ileus = Paralytic ileus (20)]

Bradycardia. A LADDER - one option only - but it ADDS TO the five independent cardiovascular items [absent = Absent (0); 50-59 = Heart rate 50 to 59 (10); 40-49 = Heart rate 40 to 49 (20); below-40 = Heart rate below 40 (30)]
Other ECG changes (QT prolongation, low voltage, bundle branch block, non-specific ST-T changes, or heart block). ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY - this is not a ladder option.
Pericardial or pleural effusion. ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY - this is not a ladder option.
Pulmonary edema. ADDS 15 INDEPENDENTLY - this is not a ladder option.
Cardiomegaly. ADDS 15 INDEPENDENTLY - this is not a ladder option.
Hypotension. ADDS 20 INDEPENDENTLY - this is not a ladder option.
Hyponatremia. ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY. NOT specific to hypothyroidism - all five together total 50.
Hypoglycemia. ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY. NOT specific to hypothyroidism - all five together total 50.
Hypoxemia. ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY. NOT specific to hypothyroidism - all five together total 50.
Hypercarbia. ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY. NOT specific to hypothyroidism - all five together total 50.
Decrease in glomerular filtration rate. ADDS 10 INDEPENDENTLY. NOT specific to hypothyroidism - all five together total 50.
